mechanism: Use a causal daily profit lock on aligned vault ADDs: trade a depth-capped core position until at least 4 USD is realized for the UTC day, then keep scanning and admit only one 75 USD probe for each new vault, with executable-net stop and take-profit exits.
temporal_operator: Process TRAIN signals strictly in observable-time order. Before each signal, sum only PnL from same-day admitted trades whose causal exits already occurred. Below 4 USD use up to 600 USD bounded by visible two-sided depth; at or above 4 USD use 75 USD only for a vault not previously admitted that day. Close at the first observed fully liquidatable net -50 or +100 bps crossing, otherwise at one hour.
conditioning: first leader fill at least 100 USD known at signal time
core notional capped by visible two-sided depth and 600 USD
post-lock new-vault probe fixed at 75 USD
maximum one admitted entry per vault and coin per UTC day
executable-net stop loss 50 bps and take profit 100 bps
canonical costs and exact observed five-level VWAP
same identities and sizes for direction-flip placebo
only complete causal actual and placebo episodes aggregated
execution_translation: Paper-only stateful risk controller. The process always scans, while exposure drops after realized daily profit and every position has a causal loss and profit boundary. No order, collector, future PnL, or invented liquidity is used.
prediction_target: At least 4 USD net per TRAIN day with eight trades across three days, profit factor above one, placebo beaten, positive 431-trial-adjusted total lower bound, top positive trade share and largest vault and coin shares at most 60 percent, all episodes complete, and net-risk exits audited.
falsification_test: Reject this single fixed policy if any TRAIN gate fails. Heldout and forward remain unopened before physical freeze.
notes: One fixed TRAIN policy is registered before outcomes. Finite below-normal CPU execution only; no GPU, network, collector, or live order.
rationale: V18 delivered eight diversified all-winning trades and more than 4 USD/day but failed only because dollar gains were concentrated in one day. A causal realized-profit lock plus small new-vault probes targets daily dispersion while preserving sample breadth, continuous scanning, and bounded downside.
